page.layout: Running head top centre with page number at left. Below it, two circular medallion portraits side by side, each with a marginal legend. Below them, two paragraphs of running text in one column, each beginning with a name in capitals. Below the text, a decorative ornament (no text).

main_text.l: NACHOR FIL. SAR
THARE FIL NAC
NACHOR, filius Sarug, cum esset annorum 29 genuit
Thare, anno mundi 1879. ante Christum natum 2083. vixit
postea 119.annos, generans filios ac filias. in summa vixit annos
148. & mortuus est. Gene.11. Circa haec tempora Sicyoniorum
regnum incepit, quibus primus rex fuit Aegialeus, à quo Aegia-
lea dicta, quae nunc Peloponnesus. Consule Plin.lib.4.cap.5.
THARE, filius Nachor, septuaginta annos natus genuit
Abram(qui postea vocatus est Abraham)anno à mundo condi-
to 1949.ante Christum natum 2013. genuit praeterea alterum
nomine Nachor,& Aran: vixitque in summa 205.annos. Porrò
Abraham genuit Ismaël & Isaac, ut videbitur inferius. Nachor,
frater Abraham, ex Melcha genuit Hus, patrē Iob, & Camuel,
patrem Syrorum, ac Bathuel, patrē Rebeccae: atque alios prae-
terea, horum fratres, numero quinque. Thare autem, tum pro-
pter Chaldaeorum idololatriā, qui tunc ignem praecipuè cole-
bant, tum propter obitum filij sui Aran, in Mesopotamiā per-
rexit, ac in vrbe nomine Charan, obiit. Vide Gene.11.&2 2.cap.
& Isidor.

page.notes: The two medallion legends are printed in the roundels, set around the portraits (left: NACHOR ... FIL. SAR; right: THARE ... FIL NAC). A faint mark ("ııı") sits centred below the second paragraph; it is not clearly printed text and is left out. Ornament at the foot is decorative only. The printed abbreviations (vt, &) are kept except that vt was changed to ut as a vowel u. Spacing in printed numbers such as "&2 2.cap." is copied as printed.
